This Rmd runs functions for the outputs of toad application results in Lim et al.

```{r setup}
library(PopGenBounds)
library(patchwork)

dir_output <- "C:/Users/limy/OneDrive - International Agency for Research on Cancer/Documents/NoahCollab/code/output"
```


# Load genotype data and allele frequencies
```{r}
toad_genotypes <- PopGenBounds::toad_genotypes
Toad_microsat_freq = PopGenBounds::Toad_microsat_freq

# fix allele order for each locus
lv   <- microsat_allele_levels(toad_genotypes)
```

```{r}
n_per_pop <- table(toad_genotypes$pop)     # number of individuals in each population
n_per_pop

median(n_per_pop)                          # median over populations
```

# Run or load bootstrap
## For global population (K = 47)

```{r run global bootstrap}
set.seed(2021)
res <- boot_stat(toad_genotypes, stat_fun = Diff, B = 1000, type="percentile")
res$mean             # check the labels in the 'statistic' column
```
```{r save bootstrap output}
saveRDS(res, file.path(dir_output, "global_bootstrap_B1000.rds"))
```

```{r load saved bootstrap object}
boot_res_global <- readRDS(file.path(dir_output, "toad/bootstrap_objects/global_bootstrap_B1000.rds"))
names(boot_res_global)
```
## For pairwise comparisons (K = 2): 1081 pairs

```{r}
set.seed(2021)
res_pw <- boot_pairwise(toad_genotypes, B = 1000)
```

```{r save boot output}
saveRDS(res_pw, file.path(dir_output, "pairwise_bootstrap_B1000_monomorph_excluded.rds"))
```


```{r check mono exclusion}
pts <- do.call(rbind, res_pw$estimate)
get <- function(s) pts$value[pts$statistic == s]

sum(!is.na(get("FST")))                                             # 9622, as in the old code
all.equal(sort(get("FST")), sort(toad.tib_pairs$FST))               # TRUE (sort drops NA)
all.equal(mean(get("FST"), na.rm = TRUE),
          res_pw$overall$value[res_pw$overall$statistic == "FST"])  # TRUE: red dot
```


```{r load saved bootstrap object}
res_pw <- readRDS(file.path(dir_output, "toad/bootstrap_objects/pairwise_bootstrap_B1000_monomorph_excluded.rds"))
names(res_pw)
res_pw$type
```

```{r check the number of stats on monoorphic loci (M=1)}
pts <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(res_pw$estimate), function(l)
  cbind(locus = l, res_pw$estimate[[l]])))
mono <- pts[pts$statistic == "M" & pts$value >= 1, ]
table(mono$locus)            # number of monomorphic pairs per locus
```

## Plot statistics distributions and bootstrap CI for global comparison

```{r, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 3}
ggtoad <- ggbounds_raw(M = get("M"), FST = get("FST"), GpST = get("G'ST"), D = get("D"),
                       K = 47, ci = res$mean, density_colors = FALSE, ci_style="bands")

ggtoad[[1]] + ggtoad[[2]] + ggtoad[[3]]
```
## Caterpillar plot for global bootstrap
```{r, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 2.8}
caterpillar_loci <- function(res, stat, y_label, ylim = NULL) {
  f <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(res$estimate), function(l) {
    d <- res$estimate[[l]]
    cbind(locus = l, d[d$statistic == stat, c("value", "value_lower", "value_upper")])
  }))
  f$locus <- factor(f$locus, levels = f$locus[order(f$value)])     # rank by value
  m <- res$mean[res$mean$statistic == stat, ]                       # mean over loci

  ggplot(f, aes(x = locus, y = value, ymin = value_lower, ymax = value_upper)) +
    #annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = m$value_lower, ymax = m$value_upper,
    #         fill = "red", alpha = 0.15) +
    #geom_hline(yintercept = m$value, colour = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_linerange(colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    labs(x = paste("Loci (ranked by", stat, ")"), y = y_label) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim)
}

res <- boot_res_global
p_fst  <- caterpillar_loci(res, "FST",  expression(bolditalic(F[ST])),       ylim = c(0, 1))
p_gpst <- caterpillar_loci(res, "G'ST", expression(bolditalic(G*minute[ST])), ylim = c(0, 1))
p_d    <- caterpillar_loci(res, "D",    expression(bolditalic(D)),            ylim = c(0, 1))

toad_caterpilar <- p_fst + p_gpst + p_d

#ggsave(file.path(dir_output, "toad/figures/Fig_caterpillar_toad_global.pdf"), toad_caterpilar,
#       width = 8, height = 2.8)
```

## Plot SEM (standard error of the mean) for global comparisons

```{r}
res <- boot_res_global
get_g <- function(s) sapply(res$estimate, function(d) d$value[d$statistic == s])  #returns vector of stat values in loci

# the standard error of mean: sd(values across loci)/sqrt(n_loci)
sem <- function(x) { x <- x[!is.na(x)]; sd(x) / sqrt(length(x)) }

sapply(c("M", "FST", "G'ST", "D"), function(s) sem(get_g(s)))
```

```{r plot SEM, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 2.4}
stats <- c("M", "FST", "G'ST", "D")
sem_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(stats, function(s) {
  x <- get_g(s); m <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE); e <- sem(x)
  data.frame(statistic = s, value = m, value_lower = m - e, value_upper = m + e, sem = e)
}))
sem_tab

sem_tab$value_lower[sem_tab$statistic == "M"] <- sem_tab$value[sem_tab$statistic == "M"]
sem_tab$value_upper[sem_tab$statistic == "M"] <- sem_tab$value[sem_tab$statistic == "M"]

gg <- ggbounds_raw(M = get_g("M"), FST = get_g("FST"), GpST = get_g("G'ST"), D = get_g("D"),
                   K = 47, ci = sem_tab, ci_style = "cross", mean_style = "bound", mean_linetype = "dotted",
                   ci_color = "red", ci_linewidth = 0.6, ci_alpha=0.08, density_colors = F)


toad_global_plot <- gg[[1]] + gg[[2]] + gg[[3]]

toad_global_plot

ggsave(file.path(dir_output, "toad/figures/Fig_stats_SEM_toad_global_dotted_red.svg"), toad_global_plot,
       width = 7, height = 2.2)

sem_tab[, c("statistic", "sem")]
```

## Caterpillar plots for pairwise bootstrap
```{r, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 2.8}
caterpillar <- function(tab, stat, y_label, ylim) {
  f <- tab[tab$statistic == stat, ]
  f <- f[order(f$value), ]
  f$rank <- seq_len(nrow(f))
  ggplot(f, aes(x = rank, y = value, ymin = value_lower, ymax = value_upper)) +
    geom_linerange(colour = "grey60") +
    geom_point(size = 0.4) +
    labs(x = paste("Population pairs (ranked by", stat,")"), y = y_label) +
    theme_bw() +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim)
}

p_fst  <- caterpillar(res_pw$mean, "FST",  expression(bolditalic(F[ST])), ylim = c(0, 1))
p_gpst <- caterpillar(res_pw$mean, "G'ST", expression(bolditalic(G*minute[ST])), ylim = c(0, 1))
p_d    <- caterpillar(res_pw$mean, "D",    expression(bolditalic(D)), ylim = c(0, 1))

toad_pw_cat <- p_fst + p_gpst + p_d

#ggsave(file.path(dir_output, "toad/figures/Fig_caterpillar_toad_pairwise.pdf"), toad_pw_cat,
#       width = 8, height = 2.8)
```


## Plot SEM for pairwise comparisons (computed from mean stats over loci of pairwise means). 
```{r fig.width = 7, fig.height = 2.4}
stats <- c("M", "FST", "G'ST", "D")
get <- function(s) pts$value[pts$statistic == s]

pts <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(res_pw$estimate), function(l)
  cbind(locus = l, res_pw$estimate[[l]])))

se_cluster <- function(f) {
  f   <- f[!is.na(f$value), ]
  n_l <- tapply(f$value, f$locus, length)       # points per locus
  m_l <- tapply(f$value, f$locus, mean)         # locus means
  w   <- n_l / sum(n_l)                         # weights
  m   <- sum(w * m_l)                           # mean over all points (the red dot)
  L   <- length(m_l)
  sqrt(L / (L - 1) * sum(w^2 * (m_l - m)^2))    # SEM for weighted sum of loci means
}

se_tab_pw <- do.call(rbind, lapply(stats, function(s) {
  f <- pts[pts$statistic == s, ]
  m <- mean(f$value, na.rm = TRUE)              # mean over all points
  e <- se_cluster(f)
  data.frame(statistic = s, value = m, value_lower = m - e, value_upper = m + e, se = e)
}))

# no bar for M
is_m <- se_tab_pw$statistic == "M"
se_tab_pw$value_lower[is_m] <- se_tab_pw$value_upper[is_m] <- se_tab_pw$value[is_m]
se_tab_pw
```
```{r}

gg_pw <- ggbounds_raw(M = get("M"), FST = get("FST"),
                      GpST = get("G'ST"), D = get("D"),
                      K = 2, ci = se_tab_pw, ci_style = "cross", mean_style = "bound",
                      mean_linetype = "dotted",
                      relative_density = FALSE, density_limits = c(0, 5000),
                      ci_color="red", ci_linewidth=0.6, ci_alpha=0.1)
toad_pw_plot <- gg_pw[[1]] + gg_pw[[2]] + gg_pw[[3]]
toad_pw_plot

ggsave(file.path(dir_output, "toad/figures/Fig_stats_SEM_toad_pairwise_dotted_red.svg"), toad_pw_plot, width = 7, height = 2.2)
```


```{r if SEM were computed from loci with equal weight}
pts <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(res_pw$estimate), function(l)
  cbind(locus = l, res_pw$estimate[[l]])))
get_pw <- function(s) pts[pts$statistic == s & !is.na(pts$value), ]   # values of one statistic, with locus
lm_pw <- function(s) tapply(get_pw(s)$value, get_pw(s)$locus, mean)   # 10 pairwise locus means
sapply(stats, function(s) sem(lm_pw(s)))                               # equal-weight pairwise SEM
```

# Tables

```{r helper function to report stats in wide format and change naming}
to_wide <- function(long, id_cols) {
  measures <- c("value", "value_lower", "value_upper", "value_bias", "value_corrected")
  keep <- intersect(c(id_cols, "statistic", measures), names(long))
  w <- reshape(as.data.frame(long[, keep]), idvar = id_cols, timevar = "statistic",
               direction = "wide")

  nm <- names(w)                                          # e.g. value_upper.M -> M_CI_upper
  nm <- sub("^value_lower\\.(.*)$",     "\\1_CI_lower",  nm)
  nm <- sub("^value_upper\\.(.*)$",     "\\1_CI_upper",  nm)
  nm <- sub("^value_bias\\.(.*)$",      "\\1_bias",      nm)
  nm <- sub("^value_corrected\\.(.*)$", "\\1_corrected", nm)
  nm <- sub("^value\\.(.*)$",           "\\1",           nm)   # value.M -> M (must come last)
  names(w) <- nm

  for (s in unique(long$statistic)) {
    w[[paste0(s, "_CI_width")]] <- w[[paste0(s, "_CI_upper")]] - w[[paste0(s, "_CI_lower")]]
  }
  rownames(w) <- NULL
  w
}
```

### Summary of global bootstrap

```{r summary of bootstrap CI global}


locus_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(stats, function(s) {
  f <- gl[gl$statistic == s, ]
  w <- f$value_upper - f$value_lower
  data.frame(statistic       = s,
             value_min       = min(f$value, na.rm = TRUE),
             value_median    = median(f$value, na.rm = TRUE),
             value_max       = max(f$value, na.rm = TRUE),
             CI_width_median = median(w, na.rm = TRUE),
             CI_width_mean   = mean(w, na.rm = TRUE),
             CI_width_max    = max(w, na.rm = TRUE),
             median_bias     = median(f$value_bias, na.rm = TRUE))
}))

print(locus_summary, digits = 3)
```

```{r heatmap}
library(ggplot2)
f <- res_pw$mean[res_pw$mean$statistic == "FST", ]
pops <- levels(toad_genotypes$pop)

hm <- rbind(data.frame(x = f$pop1, y = f$pop2, fill = f$value,                 what = "FST"),
            data.frame(x = f$pop2, y = f$pop1, fill = f$value_upper - f$value_lower, what = "CI width"))
hm$x <- factor(hm$x, levels = pops); hm$y <- factor(hm$y, levels = pops)

ggplot(hm, aes(x, y, fill = fill)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~ what) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, size = 5), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5),
        axis.title = element_blank())
```

### Pairwise overall mean (over loci and pairs)
```{r}
pts <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(res_pw$estimate), function(l)
  cbind(locus = l, res_pw$estimate[[l]])))

se_cluster <- function(value, locus) {
  ok  <- !is.na(value); value <- value[ok]; locus <- locus[ok]
  n_l <- tapply(value, locus, length); m_l <- tapply(value, locus, mean)
  w   <- n_l / sum(n_l); m <- sum(w * m_l); L <- length(m_l)
  sqrt(L / (L - 1) * sum(w^2 * (m_l - m)^2))
}

o <- as.data.frame(res_pw$overall)

pairwise_overall <- data.frame(
  K               = 2,
  n_loci          = length(res_pw$estimate),
  statistic       = o$statistic,
  value           = o$value,
  CI_lower        = o$value_lower,
  CI_upper        = o$value_upper,
  CI_width        = o$value_upper - o$value_lower,
  value_bias      = o$value_bias,
  value_corrected = o$value_corrected,
  SE_loci         = unname(sapply(o$statistic, function(s) {
                      f <- pts[pts$statistic == s, ]
                      se_cluster(f$value, f$locus)
                    }))
)
pairwise_overall
```

### Summary of pairwise bootstrap

#### Summary of CI on the mean across loci
```{r summary of bootstrap CI pairwise}
pw <- res_pw$mean
stats <- c("M", "FST", "G'ST", "D")

pair_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(stats, function(s) {
  f <- pw[pw$statistic == s, ]
  w <- f$value_upper - f$value_lower
  data.frame(statistic      = s,
             value_min            = min(f$value, na.rm = TRUE),
             value_median         = median(f$value, na.rm = TRUE),
             value_max            = max(f$value, na.rm = TRUE),
             CI_width_median = median(w, na.rm = TRUE),
             CI_width_mean   = mean(w, na.rm = TRUE),
             CI_width_max    = max(w, na.rm = TRUE),
             bias_median     = median(f$value_bias, na.rm = TRUE))
}))

print(pair_summary, digits = 3)
```
#### Summary of per-locus and per-pair CI 
```{r}
pts <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(res_pw$estimate), function(l)
  cbind(locus = l, res_pw$estimate[[l]])))
stats <- c("M", "FST", "G'ST", "D")

pair_locus_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(stats, function(s) {
  f <- pts[pts$statistic == s & !is.na(pts$value), ]
  w <- f$value_upper - f$value_lower
  data.frame(statistic       = s,
             n               = nrow(f),
             value_min       = min(f$value),
             value_median    = median(f$value),
             value_max       = max(f$value),
             median_ci_width = median(w, na.rm = TRUE),
             mean_ci_width   = mean(w, na.rm = TRUE),
             max_ci_width    = max(w, na.rm = TRUE),
             median_bias     = median(f$value_bias, na.rm = TRUE))
}))

print(pair_locus_summary, digits = 3)
```

## Create supplementary table for all toad bootstrap results
```{r}
library(writexl)

readme <- data.frame(
  item = c("Method", "Interval",
           "global_per_locus", "global_mean", "global_summary", "pairwise_per_locus",                 
           "pairwise_per_locus_summary", "pairwise_mean_per_pair", "pairwise_mean_overall", 
           "pairwise_mean_summary", 
           "value / <stat>", "CI_lower / CI_upper", "CI_width",
           "value_bias", "value_corrected",
           "SEM_loci / SE_loci"),
  description = c(
    "Bootstrap resampling individuals with replacement within each population; pair-locus combinations with M = 1 excluded in pairwise analyses",
    paste0(res$level * 100, "% ", res$type, " bootstrap interval (B = ", res$B, ")"),
    "Sheet: statistics and intervals for each locus, all 47 populations (K = 47)",
    "Sheet: mean over loci of each statistic, with interval computed from the mean within each replicate",
    "Sheet: summary over loci of values and per-locus interval widths",
    "Sheet: statistics and intervals for each locus and pair of populations (combinations with M = 1 excluded)",
    "Sheet: summary over all pair-locus combinations of values and per-locus interval widths",
    "Sheet: mean over loci of each statistic for each pair of populations (K = 2), with intervals",
    "Sheet: mean over all pairs and loci of each statistic, with interval computed from the mean within each replicate",
    "Sheet: summary over pairs of values and interval widths",
    "Statistic computed on the original data (<stat> = M, FST, G'ST or D)",
    "Confidence limits",
    "CI_upper minus CI_lower",
    "Mean of bootstrap values minus value (estimated bias)",
    "value minus value_bias (bias-corrected estimate)",
    "Standard error of the mean across loci (variation among loci)"))
readme

write_xlsx(list(README             = readme,
                global_per_locus   = global_per_locus,
                global_mean        = global_mean,
                global_summary     = locus_summary,
                pairwise_per_locus      = pairwise_per_locus,
                pairwise_per_locus_summary = pair_locus_summary,
                pairwise_mean_per_pair  = pairwise_per_pair,
                pairwise_mean_overall   = pairwise_overall,
                pairwise_mean_summary   = pair_summary),
           file.path(dir_output, "toad/tables/Table_S_toad_bootstrap.xlsx"))
```





# Other

## Plot individual loci
```{r, , fig.width = 7, fig.height = 2.7}
plot_locus <- function(l) {
  d <- res_pw$estimate[[l]]
  g <- function(s) d$value[d$statistic == s]
  p <- ggbounds_raw(M = g("M"), FST = g("FST"), GpST = g("G'ST"), D = g("D"), K = 2,
                    relative_density = FALSE, density_limits = c(0, 600))
  p[[1]] <- p[[1]] + ggtitle(l)
  p[[1]] + p[[2]] + p[[3]]
}

plot_locus("F22")                                         # one locus
plot_locus("1A")                                         # one locus
```

```{r locus summary}
freq <- microsat_freq(toad_genotypes)
locus_summary <- data.frame(
  locus       = names(freq),
  n_alleles   = sapply(freq, ncol),
  M_global    = sapply(freq, function(f) max(colMeans(f))),
  mono_pops   = sapply(freq, function(f) sum(apply(f, 1, max) >= 1 - 1e-12)),
  mono_pairs  = sapply(boot_res_pw$estimate, function(d)
                  sum(is.na(d$value[d$statistic == "FST"]))))
locus_summary
```
